decisions.reason: The hearty loaf is a low-cost addition to the core bread range that has been listed since 2018, so there is no clear failure to admit and no strong reason to write it off.
The sweet pastry has sat in the established assortment for several years, and with modest investment and no evidence of failure, the firm is likely to keep it out of routine.
The farmhouse bread is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, and nothing suggests disappointing results that would require it to be dropped.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and has its own page, so the firm has committed to it publicly and is very likely to keep its signature seasonal specialty.
The premium stollen's publicly promoted gold award ties it to the firm's heritage-quality positioning, which makes dropping it unlikely.
